title: Can I BEAT Behind the Mirror?
summary: Chess.com community variant 'Behind the Mirror' vs online viewers at 10 minutes. The board is two mirrored 8x8 halves joined into an O/ring with a black void column between them and extra squares above and below; each side has a ROYAL king (must not be mated) and a PLAYABLE king (an ordinary piece). Five checks against a royal king also wins (badge counts checks). Tony wins game 1 and the final game with a rook sac delivering the fifth check (~25:09).
rules: Board: two 8x8 halves side by side, mirrored, separated by a void column, with extension squares above and below that connect them (O-shaped ring; frame layout sprite).
Each side has two full mirrored armies' worth of pieces across both halves plus a few extra pieces on extension squares (visual-only).
Each side has one royal king and one playable king; the playable king moves like a king but is NOT royal (can be captured, ignores check).
Five checks on the royal king also win (counter badge on the king, '5').
win_condition: Checkmate the royal king or deliver five checks.
